findings.evidence: `DifferentialSquareSupport.lean:88` has `twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_eq_empty_of_le_one (x) (hn) : x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors = ∅`, and `DifferentialSupportCardinality.lean:122` has `fullyBlockedDifferential_eq_zero_of_le_one (G) (hn) : G.fullyBlockedDifferential = 0`; the PR adds weaker self-only lemmas at `DifferentialSquareBacktracking.lean:120,126,131` and weaker diagonal-only coefficient lemmas at `:145,152,158`.
findings.fix: Remove these self/diagonal special cases, or replace them with a natural general square statement such as `G.fullyBlockedDifferential (G.fullyBlockedDifferential c) z = 0` for all `c z` under `hn : n ≤ 1`, deriving any diagonal convenience lemmas from it only if needed.
findings.issue: The small-grid API in lines 120-161 is under-generalized: it proves only self-nonmembership and diagonal generator coefficients, while nearby imported theorems already give the whole two-step set empty and the differential zero on every chain for `n ≤ 1`.

summary: The backtracking equivalences are at the right level, but the small-grid consequences added at the end are weaker duplicates of already imported general small-grid support/differential results.
